topics.title: Radio Host Mishaps & Political Controversy
topics.summary: During a chaotic broadcast, hosts engaged in bizarre conversations about gay identity and strange topics like snow queens and bone smugglers. Simultaneously, controversy erupted over campaign aide Jitu Vassily’s past anti-Semitic poem recited on the radio in 1968, leading to discussions of family tragedy involving a domestic dispute and multiple deaths.

topics.title: Teen Hacker Arrested After Grumman Breach
topics.summary: A fifteen-year-old was arrested for hacking into Grumman Aviation Corporation’s computers and copying files onto his personal computer, using a Commodore Omega computer and modem. The teenager, described as ‘bright,’ accessed the company's systems before being caught, leading to accusations of racial remarks against Jewish people.

topics.title: Racial Assault and Mouse Consumption
topics.summary: A teenager recounts being racially assaulted at school with slurs and physical violence, followed by an unusual performance idea: consuming a live mouse after preparing it in olive oil. The conversation shifts to the participant's past experiences of racial discrimination and bullying within a predominantly Black high school.

topics.title: Ben Bangs Mouse Acquisition
topics.summary: During a radio interview, Ben discusses his plans to acquire and eat a mouse, detailing the process with unsettling detail including obtaining it from a pathologist. He mentions Tom Loke who wrote lyrics for ‘Wild Thing’ and shares anecdotes about past relationships in Los Angeles; he also expresses concerns regarding salmonella contamination.

topics.title: Stern’s Frustration With Gary and The Press
topics.summary: Howard Stern expresses his frustration regarding negative press coverage following a tennis match against Gary Owen, highlighting Owen’s alleged excessive practice schedule and an unidentified friend who was in the dressing room. He disputes claims of a Nazi uniform sighting while criticizing media perceptions of his success.

topics.title: Stern’s Nassau Coliseum Backstage Party
topics.summary: During the recording of his concert at the Nassau Coliseum, Howard Stern describes a chaotic party fueled by unauthorized guests gaining access through unissued backstage passes.
